pr.title: Retry failed webhook deliveries with backoff
pr.author: example-dev
pr.head: retry-webhooks

overview.summary: A webhook delivery was posted once, so a timeout or a 503 during the receiver's deploy lost the event for good. This pull request retries the failures that may pass later, up to six posts over about 15 minutes, and fails the rest at once.
steps: `deliver` sorts each failure: retry it with backoff, or fail it now.
The worker takes the deliveries whose next attempt is due.
The docs, a migration, the tests and the API schema follow.

beforeAfter.label: call tree
beforeAfter.title: The worker posts a batch of deliveries

lines.t: find status in (pending, retrying), nextAttemptAt ≤ now
post the signed event, 10 s timeout

chapters.title: Retry what may pass later
body: `deliver` used to post once and mark anything but a 2xx as failed. It now counts `attempts` and sorts each failure with [`retryable`](ref:src/webhooks/backoff.ts:13): a timeout, a network error, a 408, a 429 or a 5xx goes to `retrying`, due at [`nextAttemptAt`](ref:src/webhooks/backoff.ts:7). Any other 4xx fails at once.
The sixth failed post fails for good. The delay doubles from 30 s and adds ±20% jitter, so endpoints that fail together are not retried together.

chapters.title: The worker picks due retries
body: [`drain`](ref:src/webhooks/queue.ts:6), which [`bun run worker`](ref:README.md:3) calls, used to take `pending` deliveries, oldest first. It now takes `pending` and `retrying` ones whose `nextAttemptAt` has passed, soonest first, and hands the same `now` to `deliver`, so one batch sees one clock.
`Delivery` gains `attempts` and `nextAttemptAt`. The log line carries the attempt number.

beforeAfter.label: flow
beforeAfter.title: Where a delivery goes after each post
beforeAfter.flow:
flowchart LR
  P[pending] --> D{deliver}
  R[retrying]:::new --> D
  D -->|2xx| OK[delivered]
  D -->|retryable, n < 6| R
  D -->|other| F[failed]

chapters.title: Signing in its own module
chapters.body: `sign` moved unchanged from `deliver.ts` to [`sign.ts`](ref:src/webhooks/sign.ts:4), and `deliver.ts` imports it. The retry code and the code that signs now live apart; the signature format does not change.

chapters.title: Delivery in the docs
chapters.body: The Delivery section says which answers are retried, how far apart, and when a delivery fails. It asks receivers to make their handlers idempotent, since a retry can bring an event they already handled.

chapters.title: Attempts and due time in the table
body: The migration adds `attempts` and `next_attempt_at` with defaults of 0, so rows that exist keep their status and are due at once. The status check gains `retrying`.
The partial index on pending rows becomes one on `next_attempt_at` for pending and retrying rows, which is the worker's new query.

chapters.title: Tests for retries and backoff
chapters.body: The 500 case now expects `retrying` and a later `nextAttemptAt`. New cases cover a 404, the sixth failure, the doubling delay and its one-hour cap, and which codes are retryable.

chapters.title: The API schema
chapters.body: `WebhookDelivery` picks up `retrying`, `attempts` and `next_attempt_at` from `src/db.ts`. Nothing else in its shape changes.
